title: SassaGrantHub Editorial Source Registry
description: Registry of primary and authoritative sources used for factual verification across SassaGrantHub publications.

primarySources.name: South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) Official Website
primarySources.publishingEntity: South African Social Security Agency (National Government Entity)
primarySources.verificationMethod: Direct inspection of official public notices, media releases and gazetted directives.

primarySources.name: SASSA SRD R370 Online Portal
primarySources.publishingEntity: SASSA Social Relief of Distress Directorate
primarySources.verificationMethod: Live inspection of public instructions, technical portal flows, and official user manuals.

primarySources.name: Department of Social Development (DSD) — Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA)
primarySources.verificationMethod: Direct statutory reference to Social Assistance Act Regulations and live DSD appeal portal guidance.

primarySources.name: South African Government Gazette / Government Printing Works
primarySources.publishingEntity: Republic of South Africa Government Printing Works
topicsCovered: Annual and bi-annual grant increase notices
primarySources.verificationMethod: Gazetted notices issued by the Minister of Social Development and Minister of Finance.

primarySources.name: Postbank Official Communications & Social Grant Division

Card replacement hotlines and branch sites
primarySources.verificationMethod: Official Postbank media releases and parliamentary committee briefings.

primarySources.name: Department of Employment and Labour (UIF Registry)
primarySources.verificationMethod: Official uFiling procedures and Labour Centre verification guidelines.
